description: Q15 selects the supplier whose total_revenue equals the maximum total_revenue, computed by two independent sums. On PrestoDB 0.298.1 over tpch.tiny, 15_v1, 15_v4, 15_v7 and 15_v10 returned 0 rows against 1 on the first run, and the canonical Q15 returned a row in only 9 of 20 further runs. The cause is inferred, not traced: exact equality between independently summed DOUBLE values whose summation order varies between executions. The tpch connector exposes DOUBLE; BenchBox's own DECIMAL schema was not exercised, so whether BenchBox runs are affected is unknown.
